prerequisites: JDK 17. CI builds with Temurin JDK 17.
The Android SDK with platform 36 (`compileSdk` in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`). Android Studio installs it.
An Android device or an emulator, to run the app.

steps.title: Create the keys file
steps.text: The build reads `treetracker.keys.properties` in the repo root. The Android team shares the real file in the `#android_chat` Slack channel. To build and test without it, create the placeholder file that CI uses. The placeholder keys are not real credentials.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: This runs the JVM unit tests of the `dev` variant. CI runs the unit tests of all variants with `./gradlew test`.

steps.title: Check the code style
steps.text: CI runs both checks on each pull request.

steps.title: Build the app
steps.text: Use the `dev` variant for local development: it lets you add trees without a specific accuracy.

steps.title: Start the app
steps.text: Open the project in Android Studio, select the `dev` build variant, and run it on a device or an emulator.
